falsification_and_limits.stop: If positive-return incremental evidence does not survive the declared controls and causal OOS review, stop this fixed hypothesis. Do not reverse sign, adjust4/20 windows, scan thresholds, remove controls or turn diagnostic risk into an unannounced trading role.

falsification_and_limits.selection_bias: Previously seen S013 development evidence informed this hypothesis; repeated family selection is not statistically corrected and is not independent unseen validation.
